did: Built the owner's yes to ask #3367: when a step of the app is left, the app now notes the screen it went to, by id only, and home keeps it and counts it per step. A walkthrough can now say how often a step was left from for another screen, and how often from a flow's last step, but only over weeks when every build of that surface sent the field, and never in a way that gives away a count under five. Older weeks still say moved on. Four fresh reviews found real gaps in the first versions (Rust Rounds' tests, counts that could undercount, finished meaning the wrong thing on hubs, a privacy leak between two counts, the web build shipping before the phone's) and each was fixed before merge.

calls.title: How the app names the screen a step went to
options: Its own step, another tracked screen as flow.step, or elsewhere; left out only when the app is put away
Leave it out whenever the screen can't be named
calls.why: Some step ids already equal other flows' ids, so a bare id is ambiguous; and leaving it out for unnamed screens would make a closed screen look like a phone put away, so counts said as whole would miss exits.
calls.undo: Record a call that moves C1068 and change the places hand-off and checkEvent's rule; kept events keep what they said.

calls.title: What the walkthrough says about where a step was left
options: Left it at its last step, or left it from this step
Finished it, or left it part-way
calls.why: The event counts a step by what was on screen, not by whether the pick was done, so a done pick opened again would read as finished again; the words say only what the event shows.
calls.undo: Record a call that moves C1069; a progress-based finish would read the pick's own record.

left: The some-ui half, #3424, waits for server#1118 to merge first, since home refuses a field it doesn't know; the coordinator arms it then.
Taps per step stay for later, as the owner said.
